notes.title: Community Feedback Update 1.1
notes.content:
[p]Since the 1.0 launch, we’ve been actively gathering your feedback and ideas, and taking note of ways we can continue improving the game. In this update, we've introduced a variety of community-requested features, quality-of-life improvements, and balancing changes that better the Len's Island experience. Discover what's changed in the latest Community Feedback update:[/p][p][/p][h2]Free Camera Orbiting [/h2][p]We've changed how the camera works in Len's Island. You can now freely orbit without the soft-lock. Combined with the increased load distance in the settings, you can now see much further into the distance to appreciate the world and discover distant islands. If you don't like the unlocked camera, no worries, you can re-enable the camera lock in the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][h2]Chunk Loading Settings & Performance Boost[/h2][p]We've made many improvements to chunk loading, including enhancing its performance and adding chunk load distance and speed settings in the game menu. You'll find that the game's performance around large buildings and farms has significantly improved, creating an even smoother experience. This also gives you the option to see islands much further into the distance, although please keep in mind that longer load distances will affect performance.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/zL4a1BL.gif"][/img][/p][h2]
Increased Performance of Buildings and Farms[/h2][p]We made some big performance improvements to large houses and farms. We re-wrote the optimisation systems that handle structures, making larger structures load far smoother and also impact performance far less when you're nearby. 
[/p][h2]Sorting Button for Storage Items[/h2][p]Are your chests filled with random resources and looking like a mess? We've added a new sorting button to all storage items to make it easier to keep your resources in order. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/9ZMwd8K.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Edit Constructions With New Move Button[/h2][p]We heard you wanted an easier way to make edits to your base. Now, instead of having to delete and re-place build items, you can use the new 'Move' button to pick up the building item and place it in a new area. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/6YiQ0mk.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Animal Companion: The Black Bear[/h2][p]Discover the new black bear lurking in the Len's Island cave network! Once tamed using a bait box, they'll make themselves useful by harvesting nearby wild fruit and vegetable bushes! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/9sDkN3d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New Crop Status UI[/h2][p]Additional UI has been added to the crop system to show its name, maturity, and watering status to give you a better indication of how your crops are progressing in your farm. [/p][h2]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/CJsDPGH.gif"][/img][/h2][p][/p][h2]Translation Updates [/h2][p]Many improvements have been made to translations across all languages, driven by community requests. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/IDSno97.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Future Plans for Len's Island [/h2][p]We’ve got some exciting events happening this month! [/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ll be at Gamescom this week! [/b]Julian, the creator of Len’s Island, will be at the Fireshine booth in the Indie Arena on Thursday and Friday from 2–4 pm. Stop by to say hello, ask questions, and play Len’s Island at the booth.[/p][p][/p][p][b]We're planning the next major update live on stream! [/b]In the last week of August, Julian will also be hosting a livestream on our YouTube channel to talk through plans for the next major update. It’s a great chance to share your feedback and ideas directly with the dev team. Subscribe to [url="https://www.youtube.com/@LensIsland"]the Len's Island YouTube Channel[/url] and keep an eye on our [url="https://discord.gg/lensisland"]Discord[/url] for all the details.[/p][p][/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/bbc4b245569dce3ef2e01f346dcd5042f25bae98.jpg"][/img][/h2]

tags.feature: We've changed how the camera works in Len's Island. You can now freely orbit without the soft-lock. Combined with the increased load distance in the settings, you can now see much further into the distance to appreciate the world and discover distant islands. If you don't like the unlocked camera, no worries, you can re-enable the camera lock in the settings menu.
We've made many improvements to chunk loading, including enhancing its performance and adding chunk load distance and speed settings in the game menu.
Are your chests filled with random resources and looking like a mess? We've added a new sorting button to all storage items to make it easier to keep your resources in order.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.12
notes.content:
[p]Hey all, so sorry this happened but a bug slipped thru the last build which caused load issues. These load issues would roll back town levels and crops most notably, and sometimes some other stuff too.  

This has been fixed and will no longer happen, but if you loaded the game over the past 12 hours and got some rollbacks, all we can do is manually fix them ourselves. If you lost any progress from this bug, please submit a bug report and share your save files and email [url="https://noteforms.com/forms/lens-island-bug-report-form?notionforms=1"]https://noteforms.com/forms/lens-island-bug-report-form?notionforms=1[/url]. In the report, tell us what you're missing and how you would like it returned. I will then manually add back in any lost town levels, or crop resources, etc, and send back your save file to your email.[/p][p][/p][p]Sorry again, hopefully it's the last time we ever have a bad bug like this. We will do whatever we can to help anyone affected and continue your progress.  
[/p][h3][b]! Bugs fixed:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug with the item drops that could cause some parts of the save file to not load correctly. Then, if the game was saved after that point, it would override and wipe town levels, crops, and some other save data. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

New bow weapon type added, and several new exotic weapons and tools to find and collect.
Skilltree has been completely remade and upgraded, allowing for more meaningful character progression and choice as you level up.
Updates to the underground caves, adding slime biomes and a secret new Slime Boss.
New enemies: Shark, Void Stomper, Evolved Enemies, and Slimes.
New intro cutscene sequence.
New ancient language tablets scattered across the world, learn the language of the ancients to uncover more about the lore and meaning behind Len's Island.
New Paladin armor set and other secret armor items.
Completely reworked the workbench, item crafting and unlocking, backpack upgrading, and progression systems.

notes.title: April Community Wrap-Up
notes.content:
Welcome to our April Community Wrap-up! We know this post is late and it's now May, but who's keeping track? This year is zooming by for us devs. We've been busy as ever with all things Len, so let's take a breather to reflect on a fantastic month!
 
[h2]Our Release Date Was Revealed! [/h2]
 
In case you missed it, we've announced that the big Len's Island 1.0 will launch on [b]June 19th, 2025[/b], with 8-player co-op! We revealed this news in the Galaxies Showcase, which featured our brand-new trailer showing loads of unseen multiplayer gameplay and 1.0 features. It was so exciting for us devs to watch the showcase on Twitch; we were all amazed to see the range of great games releasing this year, too! 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b2AGw3WH_Fw]If you'd like to watch the Len's Island Release Date Trailer, click here![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/2808e27f9ace7abda2de3372411f4d71187b2fde.gif[/img]

[h2]The Return of the Void Stomper[/h2]

If you've been with us from the beginning, you might remember one of the first enemies Julian made for Len's Island... The Void Stomper! We've decided to bring these enemies back in a brand new way. Their spikes are just as tricky to dodge as their ground slam attack, which can throw you into the abyss! Get ready for a challenge, as the Void Stomper will keep you on your toes in the caves and dungeons come 1.0!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/6154429be43ba558de15bc19b2c50dafb54c8d02.gif[/img]

[h2]Spring Build Challenge[/h2]

Last week we asked our Discord community to share their most creative builds inspired by the Spring season. Community member, wendercharles won the challenge with their incredibly grand build that takes over an entire cherry blossom island! Do you enjoy building in Len's Island? You can [url=https://discord.gg/lensisland][b]join us on Discord[/b][/url] to take part in future building competitions and other fun Len's Island community activities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/d58b4da5aafbd82cdfd5e4d68d6c53cc8b4079b9.png[/img]

[h2]The Age of the Ancients[/h2]

Here's a sneak peek of the new ancient language coming to Len's Island 1.0! We've been listening to the community, and we know that further enhancing the lore in Len's Island is very important to players. So, at 1.0, one of the ways we're adding lore is by implementing a new ancient language system. As you explore the islands in 1.0, you'll discover several ancient tablets built on various islands. With every tablet you decipher, you will learn more about the ancient language, allowing you to uncover the secrets of the past left by the ancient people. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qRzZwmF.gif[/img]

[h2]Fan Art by Gondamah[/h2]

As if voidlings weren't unsettling enough, check out this fan art by Discord member and community translator, Gondamah, showing a creative idea for a Void Shark! While regular sharks will be sticking to the seas in Len's Island 1.0, we do think this would be pretty cool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/e395b28109bc9f226e7614a521d628852a1471f5.png[/img]

With the buzz of 1.0 in full swing, it's been so much fun to watch creators experience Len's Island for the first time. You don't need to speak German to find SullivanCooper's Let's Play an interesting watch!

[previewyoutube=pzlcKUsa03c;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: March Community Wrap-Up
notes.content:
It's the end of March, which means another Community Wrap-Up! 

In case you missed it, we released a big patch over the weekend, which included significant balancing changes and a performance boost. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1335830/view/502820742193218644?l=english] [b] You can check out the patch notes here[/b][/url]. 

Now, to kick-start our March Community Wrap-Up, let's take a sneak peek at some new content coming to Len's Island 1.0...

[h2]It's (almost) Time for Slime! [/h2]
We've been working on some exciting new areas for you to explore in the caves at 1.0, including a new slime biome. These locations are filled with slime, a valuable new crafting resource collected by mining slime piles. Always keep on high alert in this biome, as you never know what enemies are lurking in the shadows.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bru6Z48.gif[/img]

[h2]The Lore of Len is Coming...[/h2]
Who is Len? Why did they end up on the island? And what's the deal with no shoes? We'll be answering these burning questions in 1.0! Len has always been a bit of a mystery, so we'll be giving more insight into the story behind Len's Island, and we wanted to share some new artwork that will be coming with the big update. 

What's going on in this image? Let us know what you think in the comments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/32dc663d3fbecf714a9df9c18be80eb92c3b3543.jpg[/img]

To our surprise, you chose Chickens! 

Get ready to capture, raise, and gather new resources from your very own chicken farm in Len's Island soon. You'll find chickens free-roaming around the islands, and you can place chicken coops around your home base to give them places to sleep and breed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JVeLhKD.gif[/img]

notes.title: Balancing & Optimisation 0.9.11
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I have a surprise patch for you all. No new content, but some significant balancing changes, and a significant performance boost :) 

As we have been getting the 1.0 version ready, we have noticed the early-game balancing being a bit off. It was a little too grindy and difficult at the start, so I have introduced some of the balancing changes we are implementing for 1.0. These changes keep the core experience and mid-late game the same, but you'll find it a bit quicker and easier to get started in a new game.

The performance changes are pretty big. We've always had some fps dips around the towns and bigger islands. We were able to double fps for most players around the towns and large islands with this update, and overall boost fps by around 30% over the entire overworld. The performance savings will differ for everyone, but overall, your fps will now be consistently higher! 

P.s. We will have some more info about 1.0 and multiplayer to share in the coming weeks, so stay tuned! 

~ Julian

[h2]~ Balancing Changes[/h2][list]
[*] Increased default hotbar slots to 6, removed some of the hotbar skills from the skilltree
[*] Halved resource cost for all basic building pieces
[*] Reduced resource cost for bed, workbench, and campfire
[*] Lowered blue berry sell price and doubled the blue berries dropped from bushes
[*] Slightly lowered damage for void and voidling attacks
[*] Lowered crafting cost of iron weapons from 3 iron to 1
[*] Lowered crafting cost of anvil stone and iron
[*] Made hunger drain 30% slower
[*] Made full belly healing a 30% quicker
[*] Made all stones destroy in 1 less hit
[/list]

[h2]! Optimisations[/h2][list]
[*] Reworked chunk loading system. Overall improved fps by ~30% on most islands, and now over 50% fps boost around towns 
[/list]

[h2]! Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed multiple load screen errors
[*] Fixed resource notifications sometimes being slightly incorrect
[*] Fixed the frozen status effect from the winter islands sometimes not going away after leaving the area
[*] Fixed controller navigation breaking in the menu when a user has no save files in list
[*] Fixed some errors leading to game crashes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.02
notes.content:
Hey all! A minor update today to change over some of the new controller/Steam Deck controls and building.

We received feedback that the X/Y or West/North buttons for the hotbar didn't feel good. We have changed the hotbar controls to be on the d-pad instead and made the left and right arrows scroll the hotbar, up arrow equip and long hold up arrow to unequip. You can now equip items quicker, and to unequip you need to hold for a lot longer so you don't accidentally do it.

We've also re-added the inventory automatically opening to the build page when entering edit mode. We didn't realise that people use edit mode as a way to quickly enter the build menu too. So we've added this back in and we also improved the controller inputs and general handling of this. Now the menu won't annoyingly go away when going from build to edit mode, or cancelling a build item. 

We will continue to make tweaks and changes to the new controller and Steam Deck inputs as we draw closer to full release. So please continue to provide feedback on how we can make things better!

~ Julian

notes.content:
[b]The time has come, we have spent the past couple of months completely overhauling the gamepad and Steam Deck controls for Len's Island![/b]

Len's Island is now far more enjoyable, easier, and more accessible to play on various devices. We will still be tweaking and making some changes to the gamepad controls and Steam Deck support for the 1.0 launch, however, 90% of the work is now complete and in the game :) 

If you have any ideas on how we can further improve the controller support and Steam Deck support, please recommend them in the [url=https://discord.gg/lensisland]Discord Server[/url] or Steam Forums. We would love to hear your feedback!

This update also includes some tweaks to rebalance some of the base-defense mechanics. I think we went a little too far in recent updates, making the enemies at night and during harvest moons a little too difficult. We have done a lot of balancing and testing and have found a much better format and difficulty for everyone.

~ Julian

[*] Decreased the difficulty ramp of enemies during night and harvest moons

notes.title: Len's Island - Gamemodes Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zb7UvQS1iFg;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Test your survival skills with new [b]hardcore [/b]and [b]perma-death gamemodes[/b], defeat dangerous [b]night raids[/b], and uncover mysterious [b]new underground biomes[/b].[/h3]

[b]This is the final major update before the multiplayer full release in a few months, so we thought we would make it a big one! [/b]
[list]
[*] Play through Len's Island in Peaceful, Survival, Hardcore, Permadeath, and Custom game modes. 
[*] Many new specific game mode settings you can change at any time 
[*] Enemies will now roam the overworld at night, and harvest moons are more difficult
[*] Build many new home-defence items such as palisade walls, tesla towers and landmines.
[*] New underground cave biomes to explore
[/list]

To celebrate the new update, [b]Len's Island will be on sale for 34% Off[/b] starting 10am, the 17th July to the 24th of July PDT.

See below for a detailed list of everything new, improved, and fixed!
~ Julian

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1335830/Lens_Island/

[h2]+ New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Hardcore game mode with tweaked settings that focus on a more survival-focused experience that's more challenging and brutal
[*] New Perma-death game mode. Same settings as Hardcore with one major difference, you only have one life to beat the game. 
[*] New Custom game mode. Tweak individual settings such as resource multipliers, enemy spawn rates, starting health, day length, harvest moon frequency, and many more. Create your own custom game mode to cater to your exact desires, or to create unique challenge runs.
[*] Reworked Peaceful mode. We have tweaked the settings in peaceful mode as well as allowing the ability to freely change specific game mode settings at any time during gameplay. So you can now make your peaceful experience perfect for you. 
[*] Enemies will now spawn at night across the overworld and become harder as you unlock more dungeons and disturb the balance of evil. You can modify this setting in the new game settings menu.
[*] New Ballista Bow. Shoot down enemies in the early game with this cheaper and smaller alternative to the Ballista Tower, which can also be placed onto boats.
[*] New Small and Large Tesla Towers. Zap nearby enemies with the new tesla towers, the perfect short-range home defence items.
[*] New Landmines. Build explosive landmines that automatically trigger when an enemy walks over them.
[*] New Palisade walls in every style. Build new wall types directly on terrain to help protect your home from unwanted visitors.
[*] New Lightstone Ward. Wards will stop enemies from spawning within a large radius, helping to keep your homestead safe from enemies at night. 
[*] Harvest moons are now more difficult, and enemy raids can happen anywhere on the map, not just at outpost locations.
[*] Allowed snapping of foundation steps above each other, so you can now build staircases up from foundations.
[*] Enemies will now also target beds during night raids and can destroy them.
[*] Automatically firing towers now require ammo. Raw materials convert into ammo when placed in a tower, for example, 1 iron shard = 10 ballista bolts
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/9fb5ae24fbae374d8bf77de2f0acb2214062da02.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed rare issue with some enchantments not working on old save files
[*] Fixed issues with houses not fading correctly and some houses being cut in half and fading wrong just for one portion
[*] Fixed canons on boats being difficult to select and edit 
[*] Performance improvements to enemies that help the framerate when large amounts of enemies are on screen
[*] Tweaked descriptions and names for various skill tree effects and enchantments to be more descriptive and accurate
[*] Tweaked Voidtroll boss fight to be slightly more difficult and fixes various bugs with the troll's behaviour
[*] Fixed pet collar collection amount not including new red panda
[*] Tweaked some areas of the desert tomb dungeons to be better balanced in cursed mode
[*] Fixed various areas across frozen islands where you could get stuck between icebergs
[*] Made buying from vendors also count resources in hotbar
[*] Fixed Ornate and Pagoda boats not refunding contents of small storage box
[*] Lots of small balancing tweaks to enemy health and damage. Overall making the Act 4 frozen areas a little more difficult, and better balancing damage and health ratios
[*] Made construct rotating more consistent
[*] Fixed baked good vendors having incorrect icons and names
[/list]

notes.title: Len's Island - Frozen Lands
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=xeJM_kZt38g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Winter has arrived![/h2]

Gear up for new wintery biomes, enemy strongholds, boss fights, damascus steel weapons, and much more. The next Major Act 4 update, Frozen Lands, is here.

Let's explore the avalanche of new features new to Len's Island in this major update!

[b]First off, your existing save files will work just fine! No need to start fresh, we have worked hard to make all saves backward compatible :) [/b]

[h3]The world of Len's Island has grown -[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/4d14286aea792fd56705b5b073f65df6e0809340.png[/img]

 The Len's Island map has expanded, with new biomes including cherry blossom islands, arctic fortresses, frozen mining islands, and an extension to the cave network. You'll discover an arctic town with new resources to trade, items to buy, and winter animals to hunt.

Get ready for more above-ground combat as the next round of dungeons are about to get a whole lot harder to enter. Each dungeon is situated on its own island that's heavily guarded by enemy strongholds with new armoured voidlings and cursed ballista towers patrolling the coastline. To keep these fights at an even playing field we're adding a powerful new damascus steel weapon/tool tier and a katana sword that can be purchased in the arctic town. Improvements have also been made to the enchanting table as we've added even more enchantments. You can now enchant your armour, weapons and tools, not just once but twice! The possibilities are endless as you can now create your ultimate custom build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/092b9a4683de58d3e22ea8793a512d0b1ec00bb7.png[/img]

Farming enthusiasts can also enjoy a variety of new farmable resources and advanced machinery in the Frozen Lands update. Forage for cotton and bamboo in the new biomes and use their seeds to grow your own crops. Once harvested, these unique resources can be refined using the new loom machine and implemented in exciting crafting recipes that help you advance through the harsh environment. 

There is a lot of new content in this update. Read the full changelog below to get all of the nitty-gritty details. If you don't want to have anything spoiled, then stop reading and go enjoy the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/c524edab76475dc51acad86078e90103c3d5f646.png[/img]

[h2]New Features & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Map has been expanded to include:
    - 4 Cherry Blossom Islands
     - 3 Frozen Mining Islands
    - 3 Frozen Stronghold Islands (Keystone dungeon islands)
     - 1 Large Frozen Island (Main town island)
     - Icebergs in the outer ring of the map
[*] 3 New Keystone Dungeons & New Major Boss Dungeon. The keystone dungeons are guarded by enemy strongholds, these are fortresses on the islands above the dungeons, heavily guarded by armored enemies and ballista towers.
[*] New town. There is now a 4th town with two vendors, upgrade levels, new resources to buy and sell, new sets of armor, and even a new weapon!
[*] New Katana weapon class. You can purchase the damascus katana at the new town, lowest base dmg of any weapon, highest crit dmg of any weapon. This weapon is a little different to others, hard to master, but effective!
[*] Damascus steel weapon/tool tier. You can now upgrade all weapons and basic tools to damascus steel. This tier raises damage and also allows for a second enchantment to be applied.
[*] Enchanting. We have totally reworked the enchanting system. All new enchantment table UI, new list of enchantments, you can now enchant armor and tools, and enchant damascus weapons twice! Enchanting now opens up the possibilities of customizing your character and playstyle greatly. 
[*] New Armor sets. All have with unique abilities. Winter Fur Set, Kabuto Armor, and Oni Armor. 
[*] New Resources. Cotton, Cloth, Bamboo, Tuna, Squid, Ink, Damascus Steel, and Tungsten, are all new in the game. Cooked fish have been reworked into different items, and the inventory UI updated into a new layout.
[*] New enemies. Guarding the stronghold islands are new armored variants of enemies, including armored voidings, armored voids, armored elite voids (voids on fire), armored lightning fish, armored trolls, and the new healer shaman voidlings. There are also new wolves on above islands, that can howl and alert wolves in the surrounding area. Oh, and there are now enemy ballista towers >:)
[*] New pet. The red panda pet can be tamed, found on cherry blossom islands.
[*] New machinie: The Loom has been added which turns cotton into cloth to be used for advanced crafting recipes.
[*] New plants to farm: Cotton and bamboo can now be farmed in all farm types. We have also allowed trees to be planted in the large pots.
[*] New fishing pools: You can now fish for tuna and squid, these fishing pools only appear in cold environments. 
[*] Shield blocking rework. We have added blocking back into the game! You now hit the shield ability key to block, you can move and aim while blocking, and if you click while blocking then you will perform the shield dash ability. Blocking is a lot more essential in areas of the game now, such as dodging ballista bolts and lightning fish.
[*] New status effects and weather. Frozen islands will give the freezing, or frostbite effects. This will damage you over time and you will need to wear armor with cold resistance, eat warming food, or build a heat source to not get hurt. We also remade the status effect UI system, so important effects now display on the top left panel. All armor & enchantment effects display on your player window in the inventory.
[*] New Vendors: Baked goods vendor at the new town, and a pear vendor added to the 2nd town.
[*] Food items all rebalanced and fishing significantly boosted to be a more consistent food source. 
[*] Underground caves expanded to fill new map size. The caves now have 3 new island entrances linking to the Frozen Mining islands. The cave network is now larger with more areas to mine rare resources. 
[*] Further camera tweaks. The camera angles and controls have been tweaked and updated. You can now tilt up and down by holding right-click and dragging up/down. During build/edit mode this tilt control becomes more prominent and makes it easier to look from top-down or from the side and freely orbit around to build easier.
[*] Performance: We changed our lighting system which has seen a big change in performance. In general, frames should be more stable and not be affected so heavily by lots of lights and around towns. We also overhauled the chunk loading system in the game, which made the chunks loads 50-70% faster across the game, reducing the stutter when loading new areas of the map. The performance gains will be even more noticeable on lower-end machines. 
[/list]


[h2]Balancing & Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked scythe abilities
[*] Decoration Item Costs: Lowered costs for decoration items across the game to make them easier to place.
[*] Farming Item Costs: We rebalanced a lot of the build costs for farming machines to reduce the amount of metal and complex materials needed.
[*] Skill tree costs rebalanced.
[*] Lowered glass cost for potions from 10 to 3 (Potions are soon going to be completely reworked into a new and improved system soon)
[*] Changed rug placement to ignore all collisions so they can be far easier placed and also now allow overlapping for unique designs. Made all the rugs cheaper so it's more viable to place large amounts of them to completely cover the flooring with carpet designs. 
[*] Enchantment table build cost altered, change workbench unlock level for the table from level 4 to level 3. 
[/list]


[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed cursor not working correctly for gamepad controls
[*] We fixed hundreds of various bugs over the past months as part of this update, too many to list.
[/list]

As always, there will probably be stuff we missed and small issues here and there for the first few days. If you experience any problems, please be patient and report a bug so we can fix it! We are also a ver small team of 4 developers, we will work our hardest over the next couple of weeks to make sure everything is silky smooth.

- Julian

notes.content:
[h3]So what's around the corner for Len's Island?[/h3]

We’ve been working hard on a bunch of new content, and I thought it’d be good to show you what to expect from us in the next few months.

We have two updates dropping very soon: the first one is the Community update releasing in March and the second one is the Arctic update releasing only one month later, in April. We made a quick update video showing some more details below.

[previewyoutube=ZsIgdH7lL_o;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][h3]Community Update - Releasing March 2024[/h3][/b]
The Community Update combines the most requested ideas and feedback from the Len’s Island community into one game-changing update! 

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New Camera Rotation and Zoom Levels will allow players to freely move the camera - a highly requested feature from the community!
[*] New Starter Guide to help new players get started in Len's Island. If each step is completed in a section of the guide, players will be rewarded with items to assist them on their journey. 
[*] Additional Language Support will be released in this update. You will be able to play Len's Island in Portuguese, French, Russian, Japanese and Korean! 
[*] Resource Mining Outpost Upgrading will allow players to purchase the mining outposts at a lower price and upgrade them up to three times to receive more resources. 
[/list]

[b][h3]Arctic Update - Releasing April 2024[/h3][/b]
The Arctic Update will be the next to be released, bringing a massive new expansion to Len’s Island doubling the size of the map! 

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New Biomes / Map Expansion
[*] Enemy Strongholds
[*] New modes of Transport
[*] Damascus steel weapons
[*] Enchanting Upgrades
[*] More farming/crafting progression
[*] A whole lot more!
[/list]

That's all I'm allowed to show for now, there will be more update videos and posts as we draw closer. There's a lot to look forward to just around the corner, so stay tuned!

~ Julian

notes.title: Harvest Moon Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/774ca5ec9e84967b918a182ff8892b204ce583cb.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]The next major update to Len’s Island is out now![/b][/h3]

[b]The Harvest Moon update brings a new lunar event that will take place every 5 in-game days, as well as the heavily requested town advancement system. [/b]

[previewyoutube=16GisOIqAZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

Harvest Moons boost the growth of all crops and boost the processing speed of the brand new outposts scattered across the map. There are new ballista towers and cannons to help defend your outposts, as well as improvements to the building system. But there's no need to fear, you can easily skip the harvest moons be sleeping in a bed or staying down inside the caves!

Every town in the game can now be levelled up multiple times at the brand new town boards. Advancing a town to the next level will change the look and aesthetics of the town, unlock new NPC’s for trading, and eventually, unlock teleporters! 

In addition to the new event and town changes, we’ve packed in many other improvements and fixes. Such as, rabbits, player-built portals, easier vision in the dark, expanded storage items, and many balancing changes and bug fixes.

All of the content in this update can be accessed in existing save files, the new outpost islands will now spawn randomly in empty areas in the ocean. You won’t need to restart your save!

This update also includes a lot of various balancing tweaks and polish to improve the game from start to finish. We try to improve all aspects of the game with every major update, instead of just focusing on new content and leaving the rest behind. So many of the items in the Tweaks & Balancing Changes section are general improvements based on community feedback.

~ Julian

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/50f130b9eda194d09302e39215d2c80a4b8833b9.png[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]New Harvest Moon event[/b] will now take place every 5 in-game days. Harvest moons boost crop growth by 4 times, and boost outpost production by 7-10 times. During harvest moons voidlings will spawn around the map, and waves of enemies will attack your purchased outposts. Harvest moons can be easily skipped by sleeping in a bed, or staying down in the caves.
[*][b] Three new islands with new Outposts have been added.[/b] You can talk to Jack the pirate to receive the locations of the Lumber Mill, Mining Quarry, and Metal Refinery Outposts. The outposts are for sale and can be purchased at any time for 1,000 gold each. They will passively generate resources without the need of fuel. Their outputs will automatically store in the Wood Pile, Stone Pile, and the new Metal Chest.
[*] [b]New Town Upgrading System[/b] added into the game. Every town now has a Town Board that can be opened, this is where you can provide resources to upgrade the town to the next level. notes.title: Patch 0.6.04
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Look I know in the patch yesterday I said we wouldn't do one today.. but look we couldn't help ourselves. I've seen the feedback that the dungeons might be a bit too hard, so this is the first balancing patch to turn things down a tad, and we will see how we go. 

Please keep the feedback and bug reports coming, and we will keep working to improve the experience as much as possible. 

It's worth mentioning that I do read through every comment here on Steam and Discord, and wherever else I can find someone yelling stuff about Len's Island. I read through it all, good or bad. I've read through some comments that are very very kind and some absolutely shocking walls of text screaming at me (that have also been very useful to make the game better when I set aside my feelings). Please don't see this as an invite to start yelling at me haha, but I want it to be super clear that I understand, and consider everyone's opinions and ideas. Especially the passionate ones. 

The whole point of why Len's Island is so special, is the fact that so many genres, and so many kinds of players can all meet in the middle and enjoy the same game. Though that recipe is not easy to make. 
Some of you wish the dungeons we're even harder, some wish there were no dungeons, some are too busy fishing to care. Everyone exists inside the same game, and it's my job to find a way to make that work. So please keep all the feedback coming, so I can keep making it work :) 

~ Julian

notes.content:
Hey!

Sorry for the bumpy start with this patch everyone. 

For anyone that opened the game during the few minutes the bad patch was up, this next patch will fix your save files from not showing and unlock them.

Throughout that process a bug slipped through our fingers that caused this issue. notes.title: Len's Island - Cursed Underworld
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/c6584f245ad6225b4aa4185d6cc82fea1fd8785b.png[/img]

[b]I know we said our last big update "was the biggest update ever", but seriously, this Cursed Underworld update, is the biggest update ever. [/b]

I do [b]highly [/b]recommend starting a new playthrough, as the entire game is just so much better from the ground up. However, your save files will still work and you won't be forced to restart. It's just a ton of fun to play over and you'll be missing out on content otherwise. 

We've added dozens of massive new features and pillars of gameplay that truly expand the experience of Len's Island, as well as rebuilding and rebalancing the entire game from the ground up.

Get yourself prepared for the biggest changelog you've ever seen. I'll add some pictures in between so you don't get too bored.
~ Julian

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/d842fe1503c7726b1fb91caa645eea4d0b39b132.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Features & Changes[/h2]

[h3]Armor & Enchanting[/h3]
[list]
[*] New armor sets and outfits added to the game
[*] New player window in the backpack for equipping wearables and tracking active abilities.
[*] New wearable abilities for every armor and outfit piece in the game. Abilities such as reflecting damage to enemies, seeing fishing pools on your map, damage resistance, viking fury, farming bonuses, and so much more.
[*] New enchanting table can be built for socketing runes into weapons and tools.
[*] 11 new enchantment runes added. Enchantments such as chain lightning, ignite, lifesteal, illuminate, holographic, and so much more.
[*] New armor stands added for displaying and quickly equipping armor and outfits.
[*] New anvil added for upgrading your tools and weapons.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/5d85f954ccb815cb95228c40ef5ec93d661d1b92.jpg[/img]

[h3]Combat & Cursed Dungeons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shields reworked with new shield-bash ability that dashes you forward while knocking back and stunning enemies.
[*] Torches reworked with a new ability that knocks back enemies with a small chance to catch them on fire.
[*] All weapons reanimated with new attacks, much stronger and better feeling abilities, reworked timing and rebalanced from the ground up.
[*] Every dungeon in Len's Island can now be "Cursed". Cursed mode is a hardcore version of the dungeon that is completely different from the base level. New enemies, new obstacles and traps, much darker and scarier, rare rewards and epic loot.
[*] New cursed versions of the Void Boar and Void Troll boss fights, good luck.
[*] New achievements for completing cursed bosses and defeating all cursed dungeons.  
[*] New detailed weapon popup UI showing specific stats and enchantments for all items in the game.
[*] Every dungeon in the game has been rebuilt from the ground up, many major changes and new additions to every level. 
[*] Several new "elite" enemies found in both normal and cursed dungeons. 
[*] Enemies and animals can now fully navigate into and around your buildings. Trapped animals will save and stay at their location.
[*] New Lightstone torch that ignores the cursed void darkness.
[*] New traps and hazards found in cursed dungeons.
[/list]


[h3]Peaceful Gamemode[/h3]
Yes you heard it, you can now peacefully play Len's Island if intense combat and dying isn't your thing. Don't drop your backpack on death, don't lose health from falling off of cliffs, don't lose health from hunger, and enemy eye-sight is reduced significantly so you can explore the dungeons far more easily. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/40f859e6a824ec1407e1fa0178d5b3f90479c627.jpg[/img]

[h3]Procedural Caves[/h3]
The entire map of Len's Island is now mirrored in a gigantic underground cave network. You can freely build anywhere in the caves, you can use them to navigate and traverse between islands, find rare resources, complete puzzles and building challenges, and grow mushroom farms. I know this is just one little section in these notes, but this is a MASSIVE change that literally doubles the size of the world in Len's Island.

[h3]Survival & Farming[/h3]
[list]
[*] New stag and doe deer animals roaming all forest islands
[*] New resources added: Animal hide, Tanned leather, Raw venison, Cooked venison, Venison & Mushroom Pie, Health Potion, Health Flask, and Regeneration Potions.
[*] Bigger skill tree completely remade in a new window with more skills, sleek new design and lots of room for expansion in the future.
[*] Starting health and backpack sizes rebalanced.
[*] You now drop your entire backpack of resources when you die, except gold. Your XP and levels are not affected by dying either. 
[*] Trees now knock down other trees.
[*] Crops now die after not watered for 5 days, dead crops can be harvested for fibers.
[*] Added ability to grow mushrooms in farms within the caves.
[*] All food and health item's recipes and buffs completely rebalanced.
[*] New hunger and armor bars.
[*] Passively heal from having a full hunger bar, lose health until minimum of 10 hp when starving.
[*] Trees regrow naturally much slower, stumps can be watered to make a tree grow back the next day.
[*] Changed controls for watering and gathering plants & trees to make them easier and more simple.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/c357c07f88b9501b614266bc752e11c3128a8676.jpg[/img]

[h3]Improved Controls and UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] All resources are now drag and droppable from the inventory.
[*] You can now drag any item in the game onto the ground, or onto your hotbar, or into a chest.
[*] Added new double-click quick actions for all items so you can quickly move items in and out of chests, or your hotbar, or onto your armor slots.
[*] Generally improved and reworked a significant amount of the UI across the game.
[*] New recipes and fuels list on every machine so you always know exactly how to make any item.  
[/list]

[h3]Everything Else That's New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bridgewater town is GONE. There are now 3 towns spread across the map, with some old crowd-favorite villagers coming back into the game. 
[*] NPC dialogue system overhauled and more in-depth.
[*] Lots of new items to buy and sell across all of the towns. 
[*] New player model with new, more detailed, clothing.
[*] Added back end for ability to make Steam workshop clothing in the future.
[*] Lightning strikes during thunderstorms that can light stuff on fire, including you. 
[*] WASD and mouse control schemes merged together for ease-of-use
[*] New Steam deck compatibility controls.
[*] One billion bug fixes.
[*] A bunch of other stuff we forget.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/10d38bc1e057c6c3f7811d494795317a22499be4.jpg[/img]

We have really put everything into this update. Since the moment Uncharted Waters came out, we've been working on this day in and day out. We've been sleeping at the office the past couple weeks and pulling a lot of all-nighters to get this done. So we will probably be a little burnt out over the next week. So please have some patience for when the inevitable bugs and issues arise that we will need to patch. We will be working our hardest to make sure this update stays as smooth as possible. However we do need to consider our health, so we might be a couple of days late here and there.

Thank you all so much for patiently waiting for this, it's just one, of many many more huge massive gigantic updates to come to Len's Island. If you think this is cool, just wait till the next one.

~ Julian

[*] Procedurally generated ocean currents new generate throughout the ocean in all worlds.
[*] Added basic controller support, with full player controls, virtual cursor support and various other tweaked across the game to make controller play more fun and engaging. 
[*] New optimization system improving frame rates around player buildings and farms by 10-20%. *Were still working on further optimizations and specifically optimization the town significantly

notes.title: Festivus Update 0.5.05
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/466b34c0c0399f03dc47f469e8cd701f248d1bfe.jpg[/img]

[h2]Len's Island has opened it's very first Festivus![/h2]
[b]What is a Festivus you say? It's a holiday for everyone, an update for the rest of us.[/b]

Festivus adds a new limited-time only decoration shop into Bridgewater, Festive Frank's!

[i]Sorry about the hiccup with this patch going live everyone, it's been a long day... All is fixed now and your save files should load as expected.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/1e21f644e29d667cff42ae38753b437b3d341fea.jpg[/img]

Festive Frank's will be open for two weeks, selling a few special items to decorate your home with. These items can be bought with with in-game gold, at his shop. Festive items will stay unlocked even after the update has ended, in the future we will make special items will also sync across all of your save files. For now they unlock per-save-file. Festive Frank's is just a small shop at the moment, his shop will re-open every time we celebrate a festival or event, with more and more items added to his shop every time.

(No special event items will ever be purchased with real currency, screw that)

We also added several new non-festive decorations, such as kitchen wall cabinets, small floor benches, large curtains and small curtains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/6a7b5fa38593fa6d21480b26ed5a47e04f2def56.jpg[/img]

Along with some fun new items to keep you occupied, we have bundled in many bug fixes, balancing tweaks, performance improvements and more. 

We have been working to the bone for months to get out this update and release daily patches since launch. In case you didn't know, there's only three developers working on Len's Island. We will be taking some time off over Christmas and the new year to catch up on sleep and focus on our health. If needed, we can release a patch after Christmas to fix any urgent issues, otherwise the next update won't be until mid January.

There's a lot of exiting stuff planned for next year. Now the game has been remade with the Uncharted Waters update, we can go full steam ahead with weekly and monthly significant content updates, and constant patches. 2023 is the year Len's Island is going to go bonkers with progress, so buckle in for the ride!

Have a great end of year everyone, and thank you for all the support and love <3
See below for a details changelog of all of the changes in this update.

~ Julian

notes.title: Len's Island - Uncharted Waters
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/a4cdc04372ae05b5294a66700fa7004ab56fec11.jpg[/img]

[b]Uncharted Waters is here! This is a truly massive update, we have essentially rebuilt the game from the ground up to make Len's Island a bigger and better experience in every way. [/b]

Uncharted Waters is a whole new version of the game on a new branch, you can access the legacy game and your old save files from the legacy branch in your game settings.

We will make a more extensive blog post talking about the finer details and our plan for 2023 in the coming days. For now, enjoy the giant feature list of juicy new content to dive into!

[h2]New Features & Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] New Procedurally Generated World to explore and conquer. The total size of the map and dungeons is around 50x the original Len's Island.
[*] Five new biomes including Dark Forests, Deserts, Tropical Islands, Mediterranean Plains Islands and new Birch Forests.
[*] New boats and rafts with various styles to help you sail across the new open-world.
[*] World map with fog of war, custom map markers and a backpack drop locations.
[*] New leveling/XP system with a detailed skill tree to give you a wide array of special skills and permanent character upgrades to aid you both in and out of combat.
[*] New and improved upgradable town system with villager home building, trading, mining outposts, blueprint purchasing and player housing areas. Build houses for villagers so they can move in and open their shops for trading.
[*] 18 new music tracks (Soundtrack Album 2) composed specially for the new biomes and environments added to the game. 
[*] Several new enemy types and a new boss.
[*] New weather system with various different weather types such as rain, storms, fog, strong wind, and sandstorms.
[*] New game tutorial to help you get started.
[*] Various new resources, foods, farming items and seeds added to the game.
[*] Dozens of new dungeons around the map to unlock, mine and explore within.
[*] Several new dungeon biomes and unique areas to explore, with various new traps, puzzles, and loot to find.
[*] New Wood Pile, Stone Pile storage items to help you store vast amounts of resources for building.
[*] Special Void Chest with a magical shared inventory between your entire world.
[*] Weapons now have tiers that determine what kind of resources they're effective against
[*] Workbench and item crafting overhauled with all new weapons and game progression.
[*] Improved farming system with upgradeable water towers that can water more crops over a larger radius.
[*] New smelter machine for crafting various metal ingots for advanced crafting. 
[*] New alchemy table for brewing potions to aid you in combat.
[*] Added new bird wildlife such as finches, crows, seagulls, and bats.
[*] Beds now need to be inside a home to be used and act as a spawn point. 
[*] Destroy floating barrels with your boat to harvest various loot.
[*] New Foundation Extension and Half-Turn Stairs construction pieces added.
[*] Several new decoration items added.
[*] Literally thousands of bug fixes, performance improvements, UI and accessibility improvements and overall tweaks and polish to the game. 
[/list]

There's probably a bunch more stuff we are forgetting, though we have been working tirelessly for 9 months to get you all this new version of Len's Island, we sure hope you enjoy it!

Keep an eye out for our updated blog post in the new few days which will go over more details. 

- Julian

notes.title: Keymapping Update
notes.content:
[h1]Keymapping Update 0.1.7[/h1]

Hey everyone, keymapping is now in the game! We have been rewriting all of the control systems within the game as part of a big change to allow for more flexibility and usability with our control schemes. You can now set custom keys and bindings for the controls within the game, with two separate maps, one for WASD controls and another for Mouse Controls.

We are currently working on controller support and will continue to work on it over the next few weeks. The goal isn’t to just shoehorn in controller support and make it good enough, we want the experience of playing Len’s Island on a controller just as good as any other control scheme. This means we are taking our time to rework many areas of the games such as UI/UX, input schemes and rewriting a lot of old code. 
 
There are also lots of small tweaks and bug fixes included in this update, as well as some small performance improvements. We are aiming to have controller support out in the next 3-5 weeks. Alongside controller support, there will also be a big content update which we are naming “The Connections Update”, which will go live in around 3-5 weeks as well. We will share more details about this update on our socials over the next couple of weeks.

Oh and we changed the version numbers to now start with 0. instead of 1. as they really should not be starting with a 1 until the game is fully released to avoid any confusion. 

~ Julian

Howdy! This is the first of three large updates which will go out over the next couple of weeks. This update includes the new Pagoda building style to celebrate the Chinese Lunar New Year. We have been moving into a new office and expanding the team over the past month, so things have been very very busy. notes.title: Quick Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.0.3[/h1]

Hey everyone, It’s Julian here to gift you with some more patch notes! This update takes care of many bugs and balancing changes. We got a whole lot done though there’s still a big list to do. 

We have one main issue with a memory leak which we have partially fixed, we just need to do more testing to see if it’s completely gone or not. It can be somewhat solved simply by restarting the game if you happen to still get it. It’s a rare one although it will make the memory usage of the game continually creep up over time until it starts to cause issues. If you experience this, just restart the game and it will clear the memory. People may experience this a bit worse if they have less ram installed on their PC, or have slower speeds. We do apologize for this and we are working on a permanent fix, it’s just a very difficult problem that doesn’t have a straightforward solution. If this happens to you, please submit a bug report and attach your output log. This is at the top of the priority list and will hopefully be permanently fixed in the next few days.

We think we have fixed the various elements not respawning/progressing at appropriate times. This includes farms not growing or growing too slowly, enemies not respawning, vendors not restocking on time, and resources throughout the map not respawning. Although we had some reports of farms growing instantly or too quickly, which we are still tracking down. We also added in a fail-safe that will solve any unspawned items or inaccurate vendor restock times if you just reload the game. If you still experience any issues with trees, rocks, enemies, vendors or farms not reloading at appropriate times, please submit a bug report with your output log if you experience this issue.  

We are working as hard as we humanly can to squash as many problems as possible, as quickly as possible. As we want to let everyone have a smooth and enjoyable experience playing the game. There will be many more content updates and significant improvements in the weeks/months to come. Just like any EA launch, we need to get over the first hump and make sure the game is stable first. 

See below for the full patch details.

[*]Farm crops not updating consistently with the game time and sometimes missing, skipping, or pausing growth stages.
[*]Resources such as trees, rocks, clay etc not updating consistently with the game time and sometimes never respawning, or taking too long to respawn.
[*]Enemies and vendors not updating consistently with the game time and sometimes never respawning, or taking too long to respawn.
[*]Empty water towers still watering crops when placed and throughout gameplay.

[*]Wells, Windmills and Watertowers place close to foundations get destroyed when the foundation is destroyed.
[*]Saving a second time while the game is attempting to quit causing save file errors.
[*]Entire home sometimes gets stuck faded down to the bottom floor when standing outside.
[*]Half walls not fading when placed onto farms.
[*]Foundations and farms having noticeable grass clipping when they come into view of the camera.
[*]Dying next to a healing source while enemies damage you keeps you stuck in an infinite death loop.
[*]Ability to sleep in some beds within the caves.
[*]Resource pickup items sometimes forcing the player inside terrain, most commonly with fibers and flower pickups.
[*]Can use the “Plant All” button on lattice farms to incorrectly plant crops. 
[*]Not able to light a refinery until adding more resources into it.

[*]Holding down a fuel source or input source + button until full will keep the button looping trying to add more resources until manually closed.
[*]Small lag spikes when harvesting crops with the scythe.
[*]Backjack system takes your money if you place it into bed and close the UI before starting a game.

[*]Refined sword and nature sword last attacks cutting off the combo and not able to queue next attack.

[*]Encounter forcefields not disabling their sounds when disabled.
[/list]

We will be releasing several more patches over the next week or two which will continue to squash any issues that arise as quickly as possible. Once we get past the standard bug fixing stage over the next few weeks, we will be adding in much more accessibility and quality of life improvements to the game, as well as starting to work on implementing new content!

[*]Buildings sometimes being stuck with the top levels faded away
[*]Refinery sometimes not lighting unless more resources are added

notes.title: Len's Island demo week & Steam Next Fest has come to an end
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37921296/3489defde15efbd55c26d98523f03f89c0820ecf.png[/img]

[h2]It's been an absolute rollercoaster this past couple of weeks! We have been overwhelmed with all of the amazing feedback and the sheer amount of people that played the Len's Island demo. Thank you! [/h2]

Now that the demo week has closed, we are compiling all of the feedback received across all of our platforms and beginning the final stretch of development. We have heard all of your feedback, good or bad, and are now going over it all to see how we can make Len's Island the best it can be ready for the early-access release in October. 

The Len's Island demo was a very bare-bones, throwing you in the deep end type of experience. We did this on purpose to gauge the response from players and figure out what aspects of the game perform well or poorly with little to no guidance from a tutorial. It's been incredible to see the impact Len's Island has made on so many people in such a short space of time. From the incredibly entertaining videos and streams we've been watching, to the funny and whacky bug reports, or the mind-boggling screenshots of homes, towns and cities built within the game. It's all helped us greatly to understand how you all play the game and what you want to get out of it. 

As this was just a demo, we left a lot of key features and content out. Like I said before, it was a bare-bones experience. A big portion of the feedback and ideas we've received have been elements that are already in the pipeline for the release in October. Although we now have a much clearer idea of what the community is wanting and what content or features are most important. Below I've compiled a small list of features or changes that will be implemented into the October launch. This is just a small list of the key points that all of you have been asking about, there's a whole lot more that will be added or changed that isn't in this list.

[h2]What to expect for the October release:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Additional WASD control scheme and controller support.
[*] Separate male/female versions of Len with more options for hairstyles/clothing & options to change Len's skin colour.
[*] A detailed tutorial during the start of the game, teaching you the core mechanics of Len's Island (If you didn't know, the full game takes place on a completely different, much larger map with multiple islands and a gigantic cave & dungeon system).
[*] Allow holding click/auto gathering for easier resource gathering (optional easier way to gather resources that's slower, instead of trying to hit critical hits every time).
[*] Major parkour & platforming changes. The short version is we will be making a lot of changes to the player controller and platforming to make it easier & more tactile. As well as changing the way we design these platforming challenges to avoid issues with the perspective. Most platforming will also be an optional extra and not mandatory.
[*] Many accessibility and quality of life changes to UI & UX. This covers a wide range of areas, though in general making things easier to read, font's bigger and focusing on making the experience of interacting with the game simply more intuitive, as well as adding more settings and control options.
[*] Major changes to the way the building system works, making shortcuts and multi-placing building pieces easier and more intuitive. Removing click-and-drag and replacing with click to enable. Along with enabling camera panning and tilt controls while in building/edit mode.
[*] Adding lots more building pieces, like ladders, hatches, more roofs and skylights and more.
[*] Adding several more food and farming items, like vertical lattice farms, water towers, wells, windmills and several big additions to the food & farming systems (including baking bread)
[*] Overhauling the current food system, we don't like the way it currently works with the pantry.
[*] Adding a workbench/crafting bench. You will be able to craft items directly in your own home, along with crafting & unlocking many other items throughout the game, this is a big part of the game and is a lot more in-depth than I can explain in a quick sentence.
[*] Shields and bows will be added, along with many weapons, tools, and new items to use.
[*] Enemies will be smarter, with several different types of enemies and bosses. This is a major over-simplification, the dungeons & caves will be a significant part of the game and incomparable to the demo.
[*] Ability to expand backpack and increase hotbar slots over time.
[*] Ability to attach different kinds of lanterns and lights to your backpack (hands-free).
[/list]

Len's Island is developed by 2 people full-time. It's not an easy task to make a game at this scale with such a small team. We've spent many years pouring our life into this game and will continue to do so with all of your help for many years to come. This demo was another step in the journey to create Lens Island into a great game. We are very eager to show you what we have install for the release and how we plan to keep expanding the game after the early-access release. 

We will continue to keep you updated with the development. If you'd like to follow our game closer, you can watch the development diaries on [url=https://www.youtube.com/flowstudio]Youtube [/url]or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/tgXdS9A]Discord [/url]server.

~ Julian
